content:
**Backend contract ruled (#863): records are the concept, six decisions plus the producer rule, drafts ready for promotion**

**What**: The maintainer ratified D1–D6 and D2b on 2026-09-08. Drafts under openspec/changes/issue-863-backend-contract/brain-drafts/: memory-backend-contract.md (new methodology doc — four required verbs setup/share/hydrate/save, three rules, agnosticism test, Producers section, Deletion, Conformance), ADR-0002 Amendment 1 and ADR-0004 Amendment 1 (brain-amendment/1), and doctrine amendments for harness-contract, agent-authorities Tier 1, consolidation-protocol §3. All five planned OK through lib/amendment-draft.mjs#planAmendment. Epic re-sequenced: 2.4 depends on 3.2; 1.2a (heal of three pre-guard rows) added; 3.2 filed as #874.

**Why**: Memory 2.0 Wave 1 (#864 task 1.2). ADR-0004 admitted 'no formal interface today, only convention' and 'manifest required for all backends'; both closed.

**Where**: openspec/changes/issue-863-backend-contract/{explore,proposal,spec,design,tasks}.md and brain-drafts/*; openspec/changes/issue-864-memory-2-0/tasks.md; GitHub #874, note on #851.

**Learned**: (1) Agents draft, humans promote: brain/core and brain/project are Tier 2/3; brain:promote needs a TTY and a typed word, and has two shapes only (new ADR, in-place amendment) — a NEW methodology doc promotes manually. (2) A draft's body-end value ('### Notes for the promoter') is also a literal heading later in the draft; anchoring an insertion on its first occurrence writes inside the contract block. (3) The review poster (#851 §3.1 ruling) is the second producer and never touches the backend — the strongest proof of record-first; but it needs a declared write target (the invoking checkout, never the cold /tmp tree) and is gated on the lane collector 3.1a, or every review round strands a record (#795 shape). (4) validateRecord refuses type 'review' until memory-format's enum is promoted.
